Using his talent for magic, he enrolls in a magic academy with the goal of becoming a great mage. While he is blessed with like-minded friends, worthy rivals, and dependable mentors, he also faces many formidable figures—such as arrogant nobles who abuse their status, and a suspicious second prince of the kingdom hiding something beneath the surface. Academy life turns out to be far more chaotic and eventful than he ever imagined! A heartfelt tale of a kind-hearted boy rising through the ranks with the power he’s honed—this full-fledged magical academy fantasy novel finally gets its long-awaited manga adaptation!
